verdict.rationale: Gitea is a Git hosting/collaboration platform, not an AI agent or assistant with its own LLM runtime that would consume external tools via MCP; the only MCP evidence found (gitea-mcp) shows Gitea exposing itself AS an MCP server for other agents to call, not Gitea acting as an MCP client that plugs in and uses external tool servers. This client-side 'use their tools' capability is a category error for a source-control platform.
